common.footerNotice: You are receiving this because you are registered in the address book of {{association}}.
common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

invitation.subject: You have an account waiting at {{association}}
invitation.heading: Activate your account
invitation.body: The board of {{association}} has created an account for you. Activate it to see news, documents and your own details.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {{association}}
magicLink.heading: Sign in
magicLink.body: Use the link below to sign in. If you did not request it, you can ignore this message.

magicLinkRefused.subject: About signing in to {{association}}
magicLinkRefused.heading: No sign-in link was sent
magicLinkRefused.body: This account uses an authenticator app, so a sign-in link would skip your second factor. Sign in with your password and your code, or with a passkey.
magicLinkRefused.notRequested: If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this message. Nobody gained access.

moveIn.subject: Welcome to {{association}}
moveIn.heading: Welcome to your new home
moveIn.body: You are now registered at apartment {{apartment}} from {{movedInOn}}. Your account gives you access to news, documents and issue reporting.

moveOut.subject: Your move-out from {{association}} is registered
moveOut.heading: Move-out registered
moveOut.body: Your move-out from apartment {{apartment}} is registered as of {{movedOutOn}}. Your access ends on that date.
moveOut.retentionNotice: Your entry in the statutory member register is retained as required by law. Other personal data is erased on {{purgeOn}}.

boardMoveOutReminder.subject: Move-out to handle: apartment {{apartment}}
boardMoveOutReminder.heading: A move-out needs your attention
boardMoveOutReminder.body: {{name}} moved out of apartment {{apartment}} on {{movedOutOn}}. Service data is scheduled for erasure on {{purgeOn}}.

search.label: Search the register
search.hint: Name and apartment number match as you type. An email address or phone number has to be written in full: they are encrypted, so only a complete value can be looked up.
search.residentHint: Name and apartment number match as you type. Contact details stay with the board and cannot be searched here.

purge.label: Purged
purge.explanation: Service data is purged on this date. The statutory member register entry is retained as the law requires.

empty.title: Nothing matches
empty.description: No entry matches this filter. Clear the search or choose another filter.

error.title: The register could not be loaded

person.protectedOn: Masked everywhere; every reveal is written to the audit log
person.protectionFailed: The masking could not be changed. Try again.
person.inviteSent: The invitation has been sent to the person's email address.
person.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be sent. Try again.
person.inviteNoEmail: The register holds no email address for this person, so no invitation can be sent.
person.inviteMailNotConfigured: The email settings are missing, so the invitation could not be sent. Fill them in under Settings.
person.invitationExpired: The invitation has expired. Send a new one.
person.publicationConsentExplained: What the person has told the board may appear about them on the association's website. Recorded here; a withdrawal keeps the dates it applied between.
person.consentFailed: The consent could not be changed. Try again.

reveal.logged: Every reveal is written to the audit log with your name and the fields you saw.

addPerson.heading: Add person
addPerson.description: Adds a person to the register. Placing someone in an apartment is the move-in flow, which also writes the statutory register entry.
addPerson.protectedHint: Masks this person's contact details and postal address everywhere, and logs every reveal.
addPerson.failed: The person could not be added.

apartment.heading: Apartment {{number}}
apartment.registerNotice: Liens and initial share capital are apartment register content, which is a separate confidential document.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in to reach your housing cooperative's register, documents and news.
signIn.magicLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
signIn.linkSent: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. It is valid for 15 minutes.
signIn.secondFactorRequired: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.

errors.invalidCredentials: Those details did not work. Check the address and password and try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code did not match. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.secondFactorExpired: That took too long. Start again with your email address and password.
errors.passkeyCancelled: No passkey was used, so nobody signed in. Try again, or use your password.
errors.unknown: Signing in did not work just now. Please try again.

setup.title: Set up Open BRF
setup.intro: A few steps and the housing cooperative has its register. Everything after the administrator account and the name can be skipped and finished later in settings.

closed.title: Setup is already finished
closed.body: This instance has been set up. Sign in and change what you need in settings.

administrator.title: Your administrator account
administrator.intro: The first account. It manages settings, invites the board and can never be created from this screen again.
administrator.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of a few words is both easier to remember and harder to guess.

errors.alreadyClaimed: This instance already has an account, so setup is closed. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address could not be read. Check it and try again.
errors.weakPassword: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.unknown: The account could not be created just now. Please try again.

administrator.signInPrompt: The account is created. Sign in to continue setting up.

done.title: The housing cooperative is set up
done.body: The register is ready. Invite the board, then add people and apartments in the address book.
done.skippedNotice: Skipped: {{steps}}. Finish these under Settings whenever you like.

resume.body: Some steps of the first-boot setup are still open. Everything there can also be changed on this page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: The housing cooperative's own details, how it sends email, how long data is kept, and your own account.
settings.readOnlyNotice: You can see these settings but not change them.

errors.unknown: That could not be saved just now. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: The settings could not be read just now. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to change this.
errors.housingCooperativeMissing: Name the housing cooperative first; the other settings hang off it.

housingCooperative.title: The housing cooperative
housingCooperative.description: The name goes on the board, in emails and on the register extracts.
housingCooperative.name: Name
housingCooperative.organizationNumberHint: Ten digits, for example 769600-1234. Printed on statutory extracts.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: A housing cooperative often owns several street addresses, one entrance each. The address book shows one board per address.

errors.exists: That entrance is already an address of this housing cooperative.
errors.hasApartments: Remove the apartments on this address before removing the address itself.
errors.notFound: That address is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.unknown: The address could not be saved just now. Please try again.

apartments.title: Apartments
apartments.description: Apartment numbers follow the Lantmäteriet convention: the first two digits identify the floor, where the entrance floor is 10, and the last two digits number the apartments on the landing.

generator.title: Generate a table
generator.description: Fill in the shape of the building and edit the table before anything is saved. No building is perfectly rectangular.
generator.lowestFloorHint: 0 is the entrance floor. Use -1 for a basement.

apartments.draftEmpty: Nothing to save yet. Generate a table or add a row.
apartments.none: No apartments on this address yet.
apartments.duplicateNumber: The number {{number}} appears more than once.

errors.inUse: That apartment appears in the register and cannot be removed.
errors.unknown: The apartments could not be saved just now. Please try again.

branding.title: Appearance
branding.description: One colour, used for positions of trust, links and selected items. Everything else comes from the theme.
branding.primaryColorHint: The whole accent is derived from this one value and measured for contrast in both light and dark mode before it is saved.
branding.preview: This is how it will read
branding.previewRoom: Link and trust sign in the room
branding.adjustedNotice: Darkened or lightened per mode so it holds the contrast a statutory register needs.

errors.unreadable: That is not a colour. Use a hex value such as #7D5F23.
errors.failsContrast: That colour cannot be read on the surfaces it has to appear on, so it was not saved.
errors.pair: {{foreground}} on {{background}} measures {{ratio}} to 1; at least {{required}} is needed.
errors.statutoryPair: This pair carries the statutory register, so it cannot be allowed through.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Uploaded as a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, and served from this instance rather than linked from anywhere else.
logo.lightHint: Used in the room, in the emails the housing cooperative sends, and on its own website.
logo.darkHint: Optional. The top band is dark, so a mark drawn in dark ink disappears on it. Without this variant the band puts the mark on a light plate instead.
logo.plateNotice: No variant for dark backgrounds, so the band puts the mark on a light plate.
logo.publicNotice: The logo is fetched by everyone who receives the housing cooperative's email or opens its website, so it must not show identifiable persons.

smtp.title: Email
smtp.description: The instance sends invitations, activation links and sign-in links itself, through an SMTP server you provide.
smtp.passwordKept: A password is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or clear it to remove it.
smtp.sendTest: Send a test message to me
smtp.testSent: A test message is on its way to {{email}}.
smtp.notConfigured: Email is not set up, so invitations and sign-in links cannot be sent. Nobody can be invited until this is done.

errors.notConfigured: Save a server and a sender address before sending a test.
errors.noEmail: Your own record has no email address to send the test to.
errors.unknown: The message could not be sent. Check the server, the port and the password.

test.subject: Test message from {{association}}
test.heading: Email works
test.body: This message was sent by {{association}} through {{host}} to prove that the email settings work. Invitations and sign-in links will reach their recipients.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long service data is kept after someone moves out. The date is computed from the move-out date, so changing this moves every pending date at once.
retention.daysHint: Between 30 and 3650 days. A fresh instance starts at 365.
retention.statutoryNotice: The member register and the audit log are exempt. The law requires the member register to be retained, so no setting and no administrator can delete it.

selfSignup.title: Sign-up requests
selfSignup.description: With this on, a resident can ask for an account by entering their address and apartment. Nothing is created until the board approves the request.
selfSignup.stateOn: On: requests reach the board's queue.
selfSignup.stateOff: Off: the form is closed and accounts come from invitations only.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Your own language and how the interface looks on this device.
profile.name: Name

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.description: How you sign in. A passkey or an authenticator app protects the register far better than a password alone.

errors.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
errors.wrong: The current password did not match.
errors.weak: The new password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.unknown: The password could not be changed just now. Please try again.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.description: A six-digit code from an app on your phone, asked for after your password. While it is on, no sign-in link is issued for this account: a link would skip the code.
totp.uriHint: Add this link, or the key inside it, to your authenticator app by hand. A scannable code is not built yet.
totp.backupCodesHint: Shown once. Keep them somewhere other than your phone; each one signs you in if the app is lost.

errors.invalidCode: That code did not match. Check the app and try again.
errors.unknown: That did not work just now. Please try again.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with the fingerprint, face or screen lock of a device you own. A passkey cannot be phished, and its private key is never sent to this service.
passkeys.name: Name for this device

errors.unsupported: This browser or device cannot create a passkey.
errors.cancelled: That was cancelled, so no passkey was added.
errors.unknown: The passkey could not be added just now. Please try again.

signupQueue.title: Pending requests
signupQueue.description: A request stays here until a board member has matched it against the register. Approving creates the person, the residency and an invitation; rejecting creates nothing.
signupQueue.loadFailed: The requests could not be read just now. Reload the page.
signupQueue.approved: The request is approved. An invitation is on its way to {{email}}.
signupQueue.rejected: The request is rejected. Nothing was created.

errors.alreadyDecided: Somebody has already decided that request. The list has been read again.
errors.notFound: That request is gone - a newer one from the same email address replaces it. The list has been read again.
errors.apartmentNotFound: That apartment is no longer in the register. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.mailNotConfigured: The request is approved and the person is in the register, but the invitation could not be sent: this instance has no email server. Set one up under Email and send the invitation from the person's own view.
errors.unknown: The request could not be decided just now. Please try again.

issueTypes.title: Issue types
issueTypes.description: The categories residents sort their reports into, and who each one is offered to. A type set to non-member appears on the website's form, a member type inside the application, and a board type only to whoever handles issues.
issueTypes.loadFailed: The issue types could not be read just now. Reload the page.
issueTypes.empty: No issue types are configured. Until one exists there is nothing for a resident to report.
issueTypes.name: Name

errors.typeInUse: Reports have been filed under this type, so it cannot be removed. Switch it off instead and the reports keep saying what they were about.
errors.typeNotFound: That type is gone. The list has been read again.
errors.unknown: The type could not be saved just now. Please try again.

issueReporting.title: Issue reports from the website
issueReporting.description: With this on, the association's website carries a form anyone can use to report a problem with the building. Reports made there offer the non-member types only, take no photographs and create no account.
issueReporting.enabled: Take issue reports from the website
issueReporting.stateOn: On: the form is on the website and offers the non-member types.
issueReporting.stateOff: Off: there is no form on the website, and reports come from signed-in residents only.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add features to this instance. They are installed from the curated catalog and run with the same privileges as the rest of the application, so the board agrees to what each one may do before it is installed.
plugins.restartNotice: The application is restarting to load the change. Reload this page in a moment.
plugins.restartTimedOut: The application did not come back within the expected time. Reload this page; if the plugin is still not listed, check the server log.
plugins.disabledNotice: Plugins are switched off on this instance. Nothing can be installed until they are switched on again.

errors.loadFailed: The list of plugins could not be read just now. Reload the page.
errors.unknown: That could not be done just now. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to see this page.

installed.title: Installed plugins
installed.description: What this instance runs, what each plugin may do, and which personal data it handles.
installed.removeWarning: The plugin's settings are deleted with it, and the application restarts to unload its code.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: The curated catalog this instance reads. Installing from anywhere else is a deliberate change to the instance's configuration.
catalog.unsupported: Needs a newer version of Open BRF

errors.unreachable: The catalog could not be reached. Check the instance's network access and the catalog address.
errors.malformed: The catalog was reached but could not be read. It may be damaged or written for a newer version.
errors.notPermitted: This instance is pointed at a catalog outside the curated one. Installing from it has to be allowed explicitly in the instance's configuration.
errors.unknown: The catalog could not be read just now. Please try again.

consent.title: Review before installing
consent.intro: {{name}} {{version}} is about to be installed. Read what it may do before you agree.
consent.privacyNote: Whatever a plugin asks for, two limits always hold: a person with protected personal data is never shown to a plugin, and no plugin is ever given a personal identity number.
consent.acknowledge: I have read what this plugin may do and which personal data it will handle.

errors.failed: The plugin could not be installed. The catalog entry may have changed since this screen was opened; read the catalog again and try once more.

permissions.addressBookRead: Read names, apartments, who is a resident and who is a member, and move-in and move-out dates
permissions.addressBookReadContact: Read email addresses and telephone numbers
permissions.mailSend: Send email through the housing cooperative's own server
permissions.jobsSchedule: Run scheduled work in the background
permissions.unknown: Something this version of Open BRF does not recognise

personalData.name: Name
personalData.residency: Move-in and move-out dates, and whether the person is a member
personalData.unknown: A category this version of Open BRF does not recognise

findings.title: Not running
findings.description: A plugin that cannot be run is skipped rather than allowed to stop the instance. These are the ones that were skipped, and why.

reasons.notConsented: On the data volume, but this instance has no record of agreeing to run it.
reasons.permissionsWidened: The installed version asks for {{permissions}}, which was not agreed to. Install it again to review the new declaration.
reasons.personalDataWidened: The installed version handles {{categories}}, which was not agreed to. Install it again to review the new declaration.
reasons.moduleIdentity: It carries its own copy of {{packages}}, which it has to share with the application. It was refused rather than run against a second copy.
reasons.manifestInvalid: Its declaration could not be read: {{issues}}
reasons.apiVersion: It is built for version {{apiVersion}} of the plugin contract, which this Open BRF does not implement.
reasons.entryMissing: The file {{entry}} it declares is not in the package.
reasons.loadFailed: It failed while being loaded. What it threw is recorded in the server log.
reasons.entryInvalid: Its bundle does not export what the contract requires.
reasons.notOnVolume: It is recorded as installed but is not on the data volume.
reasons.moduleRefused: Its module declares behaviour that would act on the rest of the application, which a plugin may not do. It was refused rather than run.
reasons.moduleInvalid: Its bundle returned no module of the shape the contract requires.
reasons.moduleFailed: Its module could not be built into the application, so it was skipped to let the rest of the instance start. What failed is recorded in the server log.
reasons.unknown: It was skipped for a reason this version has no wording for: {{reason}}

errors.invalid: One of the values is not accepted. Check the fields and try again.

view.loadFailed: The view from {{plugin}} could not be loaded. The rest of this page still works.
view.notFound: There is no view called {{plugin}} on this instance, or your account is not offered it.

errors.unsupportedType: That file is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image, whatever it is named.
errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than this instance accepts.
errors.unknown: The file could not be uploaded just now. Please try again.

themeCatalog.title: Themes
themeCatalog.intro: A theme changes colours, typefaces and shape. It carries no code, so installing or switching one takes effect immediately and needs no restart.

panel.title: Themes
panel.description: Which theme this instance renders, and where to install another.
panel.previewing: You are previewing a theme. Only your browser sees it.

installed.title: Installed
installed.description: The default theme is built in and always available to inherit from. It cannot be removed.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Themes published for Open BRF. Each package is checked against the checksum the catalog states and then linted before anything is installed.

preview.notice: You are previewing {{theme}}. Only your own browser sees it, and nothing is saved until you activate it.

lint.statutory: This colour pair carries the statutory register, so a theme that falls below the contrast bar here is refused rather than warned about.
lint.inDescendant: This is in {{theme}}, which inherits from the theme you are saving.
lint.unrecognised: The theme was refused by a rule this version does not recognise: {{rule}}.
lint.reservedId: {{themeId}} is the default theme's name and is reserved.
lint.selfExtends: {{themeId}} states that it inherits from itself.
lint.contractIncompatible: The theme is written for token contract {{range}}, and this instance has {{contractVersion}}.
lint.missingParent: The theme inherits from {{themeId}}, which is not installed.
lint.unknownManifestField: The manifest carries a field this version does not know: {{field}}. It was ignored.
lint.unknownToken: The theme sets {{token}} in {{mode}} mode, which this token contract does not define. It was ignored.
lint.missingToken: {{token}} has no value in {{mode}} mode and nothing to derive one from.

unsafeTokenValue.semicolonOrBrace: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains ; { or }, which would end the declaration and let the theme write CSS of its own.
unsafeTokenValue.angleBracket: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains < or >, which would close the style element and let the theme write code of its own.
unsafeTokenValue.backslashEscape: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains a backslash escape, which can hide a character this check would otherwise refuse.
unsafeTokenValue.atRule: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains @, which would start an at-rule such as @import and fetch over the network.
unsafeTokenValue.commentMarker: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains a comment marker, which would swallow the declarations after it.
unsafeTokenValue.url: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode loads a URL, which would fetch from a third party and disclose every visitor's address to it.
unsafeTokenValue.expression: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains expression(), which is a way to run code from a stylesheet.
unsafeTokenValue.controlCharacter: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode contains a control character, which would let the value continue on a line of its own.
unsafeTokenValue.unbalancedQuote: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode has a quote that is never closed, so it would swallow everything written after it.
unsafeTokenValue.unbalancedParenthesis: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode has a parenthesis that is never closed, so it would swallow everything written after it.
unsafeTokenValue.unknown: The value of {{token}} in {{mode}} mode was refused for a reason this version cannot name.

lint.contrast: In {{mode}} mode, {{foreground}} on {{background}} measures {{ratio}}:1 and must reach {{required}}:1.
lint.executableContent: The package contains {{file}}. A theme is data and carries no code.
lint.unexpectedFile: The package contains {{file}}, which is not a file type a theme may carry.
lint.fontRemoteSource: The typeface {{family}} points at {{source}}. A theme bundles its font files: loading one from a third party would disclose every visitor's address to it.
lint.fontFileMissing: The typeface {{family}} declares {{file}}, which the package does not contain.
lint.fontFileUndeclared: The package contains the font file {{file}}, which no typeface declares a licence for.
lint.fontFormat: The typeface {{family}} declares {{file}}, which is not a font file.
lint.fontLicenseMissing: The typeface {{family}} states no licence. A bundled font is a redistribution, and one nobody can check is refused.
lint.licenseFileMissing: The typeface {{family}} names the licence file {{file}}, which the package does not contain.
lint.logoMissing: The manifest names the logo {{file}}, which the package does not contain.
lint.unknownViewVariant: The theme asks for the {{variant}} layout of {{slot}}, which this version does not maintain.

errors.unknown: The themes could not be loaded just now. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: The installed themes could not be read.
errors.forbidden: Installing and switching themes is an administrator's job.
errors.catalogNotConfigured: No theme catalog is configured for this instance.

composer.title: Compose a theme
composer.intro: A composed theme inherits everything from another theme and states only the colours you change. It is saved as an ordinary installed theme, and it is held to the same contrast bar as one installed from a catalog.
composer.idHint: Lowercase words joined by hyphens, for example husets-farger. It cannot be changed afterwards.
composer.nameHint: The name the board sees in the theme list.
composer.descriptionHint: One sentence saying what the theme is. Optional.
composer.baseHint: The theme that supplies every value you do not change. Typefaces and layout choices are not inherited.
composer.inheritNotice: A colour you leave empty is inherited from the theme above.
composer.livePreviewNotice: The preview applies to your own browser and to nothing else. Nothing is saved until you save the theme.
composer.contrastAdvice: The contrast is measured here as advice while you choose. The server decides: the same check a theme from a catalog goes through runs again every time you save.
composer.contrastOk: Every colour pair meets the contrast bar.
composer.contrastFailures: Colour pairs that fall below the bar:

roles.text-secondary: Metadata and de-emphasised text. Must still pass AA.
roles.surface-register: The surface carrying the statutory register.
roles.surface-register-raised: Header and group rows within the register.
roles.text-register: Primary text on the register surface.

common.printHint: Prints as a document. The navigation and the buttons are left out of the page.
common.error: The register could not be read just now.
common.separateRegisters: The member register and the apartment register are two separate documents under two different rules. They are never shown on one screen.

member.heading: Member register
member.description: The statutory register of members, EFL 5 kap. via BRL 9 kap. It is public on request, and it never contains a personal identity number.
member.noIdentityNumbers: This extract carries no personal identity numbers. The register is public on request, so it may never contain one.

empty.title: No memberships recorded
empty.description: Memberships are recorded when someone moves in as a member, and by the import. Nothing has been recorded yet.

apartment.heading: Apartment register
apartment.description: The statutory register of apartments, BRL 9 kap. It is confidential: the board reads it, and each tenant-owner reads their own entry.
apartment.ownHeading: Your entry in the apartment register
apartment.ownDescription: What the cooperative records for the apartment you hold. Nobody else's entry is reachable from here.

identity.notice: The extract is produced without personal identity numbers. That does not make it public: the holders, the initial share capital, the participation share, the lien notes and the transfers are on this screen, and the apartment register is confidential. The full statutory extract carries the numbers as well, and every copy is written to the audit log with your name.
identity.included: This copy contains personal identity numbers. Producing it was written to the audit log.
identity.failed: The full extract could not be produced.

liens.heading: Liens
liens.failed: The lien could not be recorded. Check the creditor and the date.

empty.title: No apartments
empty.description: Add the addresses and their apartments in settings, and they appear here.

apartment.ownEmpty: You do not hold a tenant-ownership, so the apartment register has no entry for you. Ask the board if you believe that is wrong.

in.heading: Move in
in.description: Places a person in an apartment. A tenant-ownership also writes the entry in the statutory member register, which cannot be edited or deleted afterwards.
in.personHint: Only people already in the register can be moved in. Add them first if they are missing.
in.personSearchFailed: The register could not be searched just now. Try again.
in.roleResident: Resident - lives here without holding it
in.registerEntry: An entry was written in the member register.
in.welcomeSent: A welcome email was sent, in the recipient's own language.
in.welcomeSkipped: No welcome email was sent: this person has no email address on file.

out.heading: Move out
out.description: Ends a residency. When it is the person's last tenant-ownership, the membership is closed in the statutory member register.
out.done: The move-out from apartment {{apartment}} is registered.
out.registerExit: The membership was closed in the member register.
out.registerKept: The member register entry itself is retained as the law requires. No retention setting reaches it.
out.boardReminder: The board is reminded on {{date}} to finish the handover.

transfer.hint: For a sale: the date of the agreement, the other party, and a reference to where the agreement is filed.
transfer.agreementReferenceHint: Required: a case number, or where the paper copy is filed. It is printed in the apartment register extract, which states one for every transfer.
transfer.recorded: The transfer was recorded in the apartment register.

errors.personNotFound: That person is no longer in the register. Reload the page.
errors.apartmentNotFound: That apartment is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.residencyNotFound: That residency is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.alreadyResident: This person already has a residency on that apartment.
errors.alreadyMovedOut: That residency already has a move-out date.
errors.movedOutBeforeMovedIn: A move-out cannot be earlier than the move-in.
errors.transferPersonNotFound: The other party to the transfer is not in the register. Add them first.
errors.transferPersonRequired: Choose the new holder, or turn off recording a transfer.
errors.transferReferenceRequired: Give the agreement a reference. The apartment register extract states one for every transfer, and a transfer cannot be removed once recorded.
errors.unknown: That could not be saved just now. Please try again.

import.heading: Import a member list
import.description: Loads an existing member list once: a file, a mapping you confirm, a preview you approve, and then the register is written.

upload.title: The file
upload.description: A CSV file or an Excel workbook. Only the first sheet of a workbook is read.
upload.accept: CSV or Excel (.csv, .xlsx), at most 512 kB.
upload.templateHint: A file with the column titles already filled in, in your own language.

mapping.title: The columns
mapping.description: Each column of your file goes to one field of the register, or to none. The guess below comes from the column titles; check it before continuing.
mapping.defaultRoleHint: Needed because your file has no role column. Nothing guesses this: a member also gets an entry in the statutory register.
mapping.defaultMovedInOnHint: Needed because your file has no move-in column. It is also the membership date in the member register.

preview.title: What this would do
preview.description: Nothing has been written yet. An update fills in what the register does not have; it never overwrites a value the register already holds.
preview.name: Name
preview.identityNumberOnFile: The file has a personal identity number for this row.
preview.undecided: Some rows match more than one person. Choose which one each is before applying.

matchedBy.earlierRow: An earlier row of this file

problem.name-not-splittable: That name cannot be read as a first and a last name.
problem.apartment-missing: The row has no apartment number.
problem.apartment-not-found: No apartment in the register matches that address and number.
problem.apartment-ambiguous: That apartment number exists at more than one address. Map an address column.
problem.role-missing: The row has no role and no role was chosen for the file.
problem.moved-in-missing: The row has no move-in date and none was chosen for the file.
problem.date-not-iso: Dates have to be written as YYYY-MM-DD.
problem.moved-out-before-moved-in: The move-out is earlier than the move-in.
problem.invalid-personal-identity-number: That personal identity number fails its own checksum.
problem.invalid-email: That is not an email address the register can store.
problem.unknown: The row could not be read.

mappingProblem.name-column-missing: Map a name column: either one name column, or a first name and a last name.
mappingProblem.role-missing: Map a role column, or choose the role for every row.
mappingProblem.moved-in-missing: Map a move-in date column, or choose the date for every row.
mappingProblem.duplicate-field: Two columns are mapped to the same field.
mappingProblem.mapping-length-mismatch: The mapping does not match the file. Upload it again.

run.title: The import is running
run.progressLabel: How much of the file has been imported
run.keepsGoing: The import carries on if you close this page. Come back here to see how it went.

result.title: The import is done
result.registerNotice: The member register entries are part of the statutory archive and cannot be edited or deleted. A mistake is corrected by a new entry.

errors.fileEmpty: That file has no rows below its column titles.
errors.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than 512 kB.
errors.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read as a spreadsheet.
errors.tooManyRows: That file has more rows than one import can take.
errors.mappingInvalid: The mapping cannot be applied yet.
errors.previewRequired: Preview the import before you run it.
errors.sessionNotFound: That upload is no longer there. Upload the file again.
errors.sessionExpired: That upload has expired. Upload the file again.
errors.sessionAlreadyApplied: An import has already been started for that upload.
errors.ambiguousRowsUndecided: Some rows still match more than one person.
errors.decisionNotACandidate: A choice named somebody that row did not match. Reload the preview.
errors.applyInterrupted: The import stopped before it reached the end of the file. What it wrote is in the register; import the rest as a new file.
errors.unknown: The import did not work just now. Please try again.

notFound.title: The page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may have been written differently, or the page may have been taken down.

seed.title: Welcome
seed.body: {{association}} is a housing cooperative. This page is the association's own, and the board writes what stands here.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.intro: The board writes this page. The headings below are what a privacy notice has to answer, and the text under each of them is the association's own.

sections.controller: Who is responsible for the personal data
sections.data: What personal data the association processes

signup.title: Request an account
signup.intro: Fill in your details and the board will consider the request. Nothing is created until a board member has approved it.
signup.freeTextHint: Write the address and the apartment number as they stand in the entrance. The board matches them against the register when it considers the request.
signup.receivedBody: The board decides it. Until someone approves it there is no account and no entry in the register, and when that happens you get an email with a link for choosing a password. A new request from the same email address replaces this one.
signup.closed: This housing cooperative is not accepting account requests at the moment. Ask the board, who can invite you instead.

errors.invalid: Something in the form could not be read. Check the email address and that every field is filled in.
errors.unknown: The request could not be sent just now. Please try again.

activate.heading: Activate your account
activate.intro: Choose a password and the account is yours. Your details are already in the housing cooperative's address book.
activate.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of a few words is both easier to remember and harder to guess.
activate.autoSignInFailed: The account is activated. Signing in automatically did not work, so sign in with your email address and your new password.

errors.invalidToken: This link does not work. Check that the whole address from the email came along, or ask the board for a new invitation.
errors.alreadyAccepted: This link has already been used. The account exists, so sign in with your email address and the password you chose.
errors.alreadyHasAccount: You already have an account in the housing cooperative. Sign in instead.
errors.expired: The invitation has expired. Ask the board to send a new invitation.
errors.noEmail: The register holds no email address for you, so the account cannot be activated. Contact the board.
errors.unknown: The account could not be activated just now. Please try again.

issues.title: Issues
issues.intro: Report a problem with the building, and follow what happens to it.
issues.loadFailed: The issues could not be read just now. Reload the page.

report.title: Report an issue
report.description: The board and the property manager read this. Nothing here is published.
report.noTypes: The board has not set up any issue types yet, so there is nothing to report under. Ask them to add one under Settings.
report.locationHint: The bicycle room, the lift in entrance 14, the courtyard.
report.sensitiveWarning: Write only what is needed to put the problem right. Details about health, and anything concerning a neighbour, are read by everyone who handles issues here - an external property manager included.
report.submitted: The report has been sent. It is now in the queue.

errors.typeNotFound: That type is not one you can report under. The list has been read again.
errors.apartmentNotFound: That apartment is not one of yours. Choose again.
errors.unknown: The report could not be sent just now. Please try again.

photos.title: Photographs
photos.hint: A photograph says more than a paragraph. It is stored on this instance and is never published.
photos.limit: This report already carries as many photographs as it may.
photos.openFailed: These photographs could not be attached: {{names}}. Everything else in the report was sent.

mine.title: Your reports
mine.description: What you have reported, newest first. Only you and whoever handles issues can read them.
mine.noApartment: This report is not about an apartment.
mine.noPlace: No place in the building was given.

queue.title: The issue queue
queue.description: Everything reported, open ones first and the oldest at the top.
queue.reporterProtected: Protected personal data: ask the board.

errors.issueNotFound: That issue is gone. The queue has been read again.
errors.unknown: The issue could not be changed just now. Please try again.

errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do that.
errors.unknown: That could not be done just now. Please try again.

documents.heading: Document archive
documents.description: The association's own documents. What each one says is who it is for, and that is the whole of the rule: the archive shows what your audience allows, and the file behind it is served on the same decision.
documents.empty: There is nothing in the archive yet.
documents.emptyForYou: There is nothing here for you yet. The board decides which documents are the members' and which are published.

audienceHint.board: The board and an administrator. Every time one of these is opened, that is written to the audit log.
audienceHint.member: Members of the association. A resident who is not a member does not see it.
audienceHint.public: Anyone, with no account. This is what the association publishes to the street.

upload.heading: File a document
upload.description: Documents as PDF. The file is identified from its own bytes, so what it is named decides nothing.
upload.title: Title
upload.titleHint: What the document is called. Written as the board writes it, and never translated.
upload.categoryHint: The binder it belongs in. Take one of the suggestions or write your own.
upload.saved: The document is in the archive.
upload.minutesGuard: Minutes stay with the members until the board publishes them deliberately. Choose the published audience again if that is what this document is.

edit.heading: Edit {{title}}
edit.removeConfirm: Remove {{title}} from the archive? The file goes with it.

errors.loadFailed: The archive could not be read just now. Reload the page.
errors.notFound: That document is no longer in the archive.
errors.unsupportedType: That file is not a PDF, whatever it is named.
errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than this instance accepts.
errors.unknown: That could not be saved just now. Please try again.

siteAdmin.heading: The association's website
siteAdmin.description: The pages the association publishes. A page is written first and published when it is ready, and each one is either public or for the members.
siteAdmin.notAllowed: Writing the association's website is the board's. Your account does not have it.

pages.heading: Pages
pages.description: Everything the association has written, drafts included.
pages.none: No pages yet. Write the first one below.

newPage.heading: New page
newPage.description: A new page is written unpublished. Nobody can read it until you publish it.

editor.heading: The page
editor.description: The page is a list of blocks. The website decides what each one becomes, which is why no markup is stored.
editor.freeTextWarning: Write nothing about a named person's health, finances, religion, politics or family situation. This is a page the association publishes, and it is read by people the association has no relationship with.
editor.scanWarning: This looks like a personal identity number: {{places}}. Publishing is refused until it is gone.
editor.removeConfirm: Delete the page {{title}}? The page and everything written on it goes, and nothing here puts it back.
editor.title: Title
editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The page is served at the association's own domain, directly under the root.
editor.pictureHint: Choosing a file uploads it at once, with the answer above. It is stored on this instance and served from it, never from anywhere else.
editor.identifiable: Somebody can be recognised in this picture. A person appears on a published page only with a recorded publication consent.
editor.altHint: What the picture shows, for somebody who cannot see it. Leave it empty only when the picture carries nothing the text does not already say.
editor.caption: Caption
editor.photoConsent: I confirm that everyone who can be recognised in the pictures on this page has given publication consent, and that it has been recorded.
editor.linkPrompt: Address to link to. Leave it empty to remove the link.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.description: The page as the website would serve it, rendered by the website itself.
preview.frameTitle: The page as the website would serve it

errors.loadFailed: The website could not be read just now. Reload the page.
errors.invalidSlug: That address cannot be used for a page.
errors.slugTaken: Another page already has that address.
errors.invalidBody: The page holds something the website will not publish. A link has to be an ordinary web address, an email address, or a page on this site.
errors.personalIdentityNumber: The page carries a personal identity number, so it cannot be published.
errors.photoConsentRequired: A picture on this page shows identifiable persons. Confirm the publication consents first.
errors.imageNotFound: A picture on this page is no longer stored on this instance.
errors.imageNotPublic: A picture on this page is not served publicly, so the page would show a broken picture.
errors.unknown: That could not be saved just now. Please try again.
